entries.english: Acquisition of estates, rights and revenues by Graf Melchior von Hatzfeldt. The file covers the acquisition of lapsed Hohenlohe fiefs of the Herren von Rosenberg, including tithes at Haltenbergstetten, the parish fief at Oberbalbach and a share at Edelfingen (1639–1643, with a later reference to 1661); purchase of the Heffte forest near the Landturm at Lichtel from the imperial city of Rothenburg (1651, referenced in 1661); and purchase of estates at Ensigheim and Gieß and revenues at Bofsheim from Philipp Christoph and Hans Christoph von Adelsheim, for dates including 1598 and 1613–1616, recorded in 1641. It also includes the sale of the Ensigheim estate by Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg to his bailiff Georg Hyndermayer zu Rosenberg and its repurchase from Hyndermayer’s heirs. One volume, folios 1–65.
